//: Browser scope: these modules run in the browser (entered through main.tsx), and serve.ts bundles them to /page.js via `deno bundle --config ../../../../bindings/ts/web/browser-bundle.json`, which stubs the non-browser FFI adapters' node:*/bun:ffi imports. Here the @pancake graph is mapped so `deno check` resolves it; the node:* built-ins the runtime's cascade static-imports resolve to Deno's node-compat for typechecking (they are stubbed only in the esbuild bundle). The lib set carries both dom and deno.ns: the page is DOM code, but the bundled @pancake/runtime graph includes the (dead-in-browser) Deno adapter, which references Deno globals. React and the JSX transform are NOT named here: Deno reads compilerOptions only from the root config of a scope, so they live in the repository's root deno.json, and this directory is type-checked from the repository root (`deno check apps`, which is what the gate runs) rather than from inside it. The fmt block mirrors the root deno.json.
